messages:
maria_cs: Noticed a weird spike in notes this morning. Looks like the onboarding playbook sent duplicate 'check-in' notes for a chunk of accounts. grabbing examples now.

maria_cs: sample ids: ACCT-9921, ACCT-4472. identical body = 'Welcome! Quick check-in: did you get the onboarding guide?'

kevin_ops: do we have a recent deploy that touched playbook runner?

maria_cs: no deploy, but webhook logs show two delivery attempts at 2025-07-02T04:17:03Z and 04:17:07Z for the same event id. about 98 extra notes total.

samira_ops: can you dump the webhook payloads so we can compare IDs? i'll run a staging dedupe job once we confirm pattern.

maria_cs: pasted payload snippets to #internal-ops: event_id: ea4f02, source: crm-webhooks, retry_reason: "connection-reset"

playbook-bot: monitoring: rule onboard-checkin-v1 triggered 98 times within 5s window. auto-dedupe disabled for prod.

jonah_eng: probable cause: webhook client retried with identical id after transient socket error; playbook runner treats each delivery as unique. i'll add idempotency hashing keyed by event_id + rule. quick PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8234

kevin_ops: until fix lands can we pause onboard-checkin-v1 for the trial & pilot segments for 90m? small curl to ops: `POST /ops/playbook/suppress` body `{ "rule": "onboard-checkin-v1", "segments": ["trial","pilot"], "ttl": "90m" }`

samira_ops: suppression submitted, status 202. starting a cleanup job to remove duplicates where body matches and created_at within 10s window. will tag each removal with audit reason 'dedupe-20250702'.

emily_re: of the affected accounts, put any with renewal < 120 days into a high-touch queue? need to prioritize outreach lists.

maria_cs: quick split: 12 accounts <120d, 3 <60d. exporting to s3://redwood-cs/exports/duplicate_cleanup_1759034567.csv and assigning owners. scheduling a quick sync with enablement tomorrow 10am.

jonah_eng: merged idempotency patch to staging and added integration test simulating webhook replay. rolling to prod in next deploy window. :thumbsup:
